summary: Master ESG integration, TCFD reporting, and stewardship for pension funds. Join our expert-led course to enhance fiduciary performance. Enroll today.
lede: Sustainable investing in pension funds integrates environmental, social and governance factors into investment decisions and ownership practices. Pension fund trustees, investment leaders and analysts can use this approach to assess ESG data, incorporate sustainability factors into asset allocation and manager selection, and conduct climate scenario analysis or prepare stewardship reports.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the long-term solvency and ethical alignment of retirement assets in a rapidly changing regulatory environment.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of pension fund investment principles and asset management. Familiarity with basic financial reporting and investment terminology is required. No prior experience in ESG or sustainability is necessary, though a working knowledge of institutional investment processes is highly recommended.
